title: Spent Rs 50 lakh: In hope for a revival, family kept man’s body frozen since 2022

After the family member's death from cancer and kidney failure, they were unable to perform last rites. Initially kept at home, the body was later moved to a polyclinic during redevelopment.

title: AT&T CEO backs T-Mobile CEO's view that Musk's plan to shake mobile industry won't work

They believe that the project's scope and technical groundwork fall short of being competitive. Stankey cites AT&T's hefty investments in fiber optics, highlighting their superior performance, while both leaders raise concerns about satellite technology's effectiveness, especially in urban areas.

title: He built device to make drinking water from air; 3 years later, won Chemistry Nobel
content: Omar Yaghi’s innovative team has created a groundbreaking device that pulls water from the atmosphere under adverse conditions. Employing a specialized metal-organic framework, their technology functions independently of electric power. Yaghi’s personal journey significantly shaped his commitment to tackling water scarcity. Their remarkable achievements earned them the Nobel Prize in Chemistry, and future expansions may enhance the reach of this technology.

title: US response to Iran's seven-day peace proposal delivered to President Pezeshkian

Iranian leaders have emphasized their commitment to finding diplomatic solutions, but the US has deemed the proposal insufficient, citing worries about sanctions relief. Analysts suggest reconsidering the order of negotiations might yield better outcomes as both parties look for a diplomatic exit from the conflict without compromising their stances.

The cozy apartment, available for a minimum of two nights at $250 to $300 per night, features original decor and memorabilia from Cobain's time. Visitors often rave about the rich history and the convenient location near downtown amenities.

The plan involves protecting 97 acres for conservation and using five acres for affordable housing. Sea Island Habitat for Humanity will build a 50-home community for local families earning below 80% of the area median income. Public access will include trails and amenities, fostering community interaction with nature.

title: In 2018, Musk gave $480,350 for Flint school filters; students drink from fountains

Students were previously reliant on bottled water for drinking due to contamination concerns. Testing confirmed that the new systems effectively removed lead and harmful bacteria from the water supply. Although drinking stations are now available, bottled water will continue to be provided throughout the school year.

title: 49 musk turtles return to Pennsylvania lake after pollution cleanup
content: In 2025, Crystal Lake underwent a dredging project that inadvertently drained vital habitats for wildlife. Fortunately, emergency response teams rescued several turtles, resulting in 49 musk turtles being rehabilitated at Aark Wildlife Rehabilitation Center. By September 2026, these turtles successfully returned to their natural habitat, showcasing a remarkable achievement in environmental restoration. The project underscores the importance of community engagement in supporting wildlife recovery initiatives.

title: Flydubai flight drama: 'Indian-origin' pilot stopped Omani co-pilot from crashing plane

The co-pilot reportedly tried to take control of the aircraft, leading to a physical altercation with the captain. Passengers heard screaming and observed blood inside the cockpit as the plane descended rapidly. Israeli authorities are investigating the circumstances surrounding the incident and the pilots’ identities.

title: 2,100-year-old Roman shipwreck with 122 tableware types found in Turkey

The cargo, believed to originate from Rhosus, dates back approximately 2,100 years. Researchers have recovered various ceramic types, revealing insights into ancient tableware and packing methods. The discovery highlights the historical significance of Rhosus in tableware production during the Late Hellenistic and Early Roman periods.

title: New York man allegedly took $109,746 in Social Security payments after brother died

Social Security continued payments into the account, unaware of the brother's passing. Darling's actions reportedly led to $109,746 in stolen benefits, resulting in federal charges against him. The Justice Department's crackdown involved multiple cases of Social Security fraud across various states.

title: Michigan woman allegedly took $121,000 in benefits while disabled uncle lacked utilities

Prosecutors reveal this case is a facet of a wider crackdown by the DOJ on Social Security fraud. Numerous other cases of benefit misconduct across states have surfaced. Court proceedings are anticipated to tackle the allegations against Whisenant in the near future.

title: Scientists develop eDNA markers to detect Burmese pythons in southern Florida waters
content: Scientists created novel eDNA markers to identify Burmese pythons from water samples across southern Florida. The study focused on various wetlands, waterways, and their connections to assess python distribution. Water samples were filtered and processed to concentrate pythons' eDNA for accurate detection. Challenges included the low density of pythons and possible environmental inhibitors in the water. Efforts are ongoing to refine detection methods and improve the understanding of python populations.

title: Russia raises troop numbers to 1.55m as Zelensky accuses mass mobilisation

The total active personnel will now reach 1.55 million as part of efforts linked to the Ukraine conflict. Ukrainian officials have accused Russia of gearing up for a renewed mass mobilization of troops. Meanwhile, military experts have expressed skepticism about the effectiveness of any new draft orders.

title: Dealer's car trip to another service centre ends in crash; customer wins Rs 4.25 lakh

The exercise highlighted the importance of dual-use infrastructure for military operations in sensitive border areas. Challenges of the desert environment required close coordination among aircrew and ground crew during the activity.
